name: Journal Entry
description: A reflective diary entry written in the first person from what you said.
outline: Write the entry in the first person, in a warm and natural voice, as if the speaker wrote it themselves.
Follow the order of what was said and keep the speaker's own feelings and wording.
Pull out a short list of highlights and, if mentioned, things the speaker is grateful for.
Add a line for intentions or what to remember for tomorrow only if the speaker said so.
Do not add advice, interpretation or detail that was not said.
example:
## Entry
Today started slow, but the walk after lunch cleared my head.

## Grateful For
- A quiet afternoon
